title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Architectural Monograph. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Architectural Monograph
options.lineage: El Croquis / Domus plate books, full-bleed project plates with a quiet caption rail
options.thesis: The studio site as a bound monograph: one photograph owns the spread; type is caption, never decoration.
options.viewport: Full-bleed Marbella villa plate edge-to-edge. FISHEYE as title-block mark top-left. One short line of offer. One CTA in the caption rail, no cards, no stat strip.
options.risk: Architecture sites land here often; without plate discipline it becomes a generic beige portfolio.

raised.raise: The first viewport is one continuous printed sheet, no floating panels or inset hero cards.
No boxes, rules-as-frames, or dividers; grouping is only plate scale, caption proximity, and paper field.
Color stays mineral and quiet; photography carries chroma while UI ink stays near-monochrome.

options.label: Limestone Cut
options.lineage: Mediterranean quarry faces, stacked stone courses, mineral dust, cut-block rhythm
options.thesis: Marbella material truth: the page is cut stone, courses of photography and type stacked like a villa elevation.
options.viewport: Massive stone-field ground. One project photo as a cut block. Brand carved as a shallow inscription. CTA as a bronze pin mark.
options.risk: Also a strong category landing for Mediterranean luxury, familiarity if the stone metaphor stays decorative.

options.label: Swiss Poster Wall
options.thesis: One modular grid disciplines every project as a poster cell, objective type, geometric rhythm, photographic fragments.
options.viewport: Visible CSS grid as design surface. FISHEYE flush-left. Projects as modular cells. Signal accent only on the active cell.
options.case: Wins clarity for scanning a portfolio; loses narrowly on villa-owner identification vs monograph photography.
options.risk: Can read as graphic-design school rather than lived luxury interior.

options.label: Village Coffeehouse Identity
options.case: Wrong audience: organic kraft warmth fights Marbella luxury positioning.

options.label: Cathode Numeral Gauze
options.case: Operate-UI language; villa clients do not identify with cathode stacks.
options.kept: No boxes or dividers, depth and density only.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Atmosphere without product mechanism; weak CTA clarity.
options.kept: Chroma confined; UI field stays achromatic.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Full-bleed interior photo, thin sans nav, centered luxury headline, dual CTAs, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Hero photo with brand + headline + Our work / Request, the arrangement every competitor ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from neighboring Marbella studios by design.
